Why is this hole here?
Cap chewer: yes or no?
Hold a pen cap up
to the light.
See the hole?
It's not there
for the ink.
Kids chew caps,
and now and then,
one gets breathed in.
Stuck in the windpipe,
the hole still lets air
through,
until a doctor gets it out.
A safety standard asks
for at least eight
litres of air a minute
through the cap.
Or a cap too big
to breathe in at all.
